shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/**' -g 'pages/**' | head -200"

/bin/bash -lc "cat lib/products.ts && cat tsconfig.json && rg -n 'cacheComponents|use cache|connection\\(|dynamic|revalidate|generateStaticParams|loading' . -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!.next'"' && find . -maxdepth 2 -name AGENTS.md -print"

/bin/bash -lc "test -d node_modules && echo installed || echo missing; rg -n 'cacheComponents\\??|cacheComponents:' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js 2>/dev/null | head -60; rg -n 'use cache|cacheComponents' node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render -g '*.js' | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view next@canary version && npm view next version && npm list next react react-dom --depth=0'
/bin/bash -lc 'node -v && npm view next@canary engines peerDependencies --json && npm view next@canary dist-tags --json'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'cacheComponents\\??|cacheComponents:' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -20 && cat package.json && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "ls -la && cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null && git ls-files && sed -n '1706,1732p' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run start -- -p 3100'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- app/layout.tsx app/products/'[slug]'/page.tsx lib/products.ts next.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json && git status --short && rg -n '\"node_modules/next\"|\"version\": \"16\\.4\\.5\"' package-lock.json | head -10"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- next-env.d.ts && cat .gitignore && cat package.json && git show HEAD:package.json && cat next-env.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "npm audit --omit=dev --json | node -e \"let data='';process.stdin.on('data',chunk=>data+=chunk).on('end',()=>{const report=JSON.parse(data);console.log(JSON.stringify({metadata:report.metadata?.vulnerabilities,packages:Object.keys(report.vulnerabilities||{})}))})\""
